# filtering regions which have a significant region after running the isorelate `r 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(isoRelate, help, pos = 2, lib.loc = NULL)

annotated_ir_result <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/isorelate/hrp2_status_wgs_final_IR_annotated_snpeff.csv.gz",sep=",")
print(colnames(annotated_ir_result))

filter_regions <- annotated_ir_result%>%
    filter(log10_pvalue > 5)%>%
    select(chr, snp_id, pos_M, pos_bp, pop, subpop, iR , log10_pvalue)

p_annotated <- plotIBDiR(
    ibd.iR = filter_regions,
    annotation.genes = annotation_genes,
    annotation.genes.color = c("black","red"),
    highlight.genes = NULL,
    highlight.genes.labels = FALSE,
    highlight.genes.color = NULL,
    highlight.genes.alpha = 0.1,
    point.size = 1,
    add.rug = FALSE,
    plot.title = "Significance of IBD sharing (with gene annotations)",
    add.legend = FALSE,
    facet.label = FALSE,
    facet.scales = "fixed"
  )

```

```{r}
library(SeqArray)
library(moimix)
library(isoRelate)
library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(ggrepel)
library(GenomicRanges)
my_iR <- annotated_ir_result%>%
    filter(subpop == "wild/wild")%>%
    select(chr, snp_id, pos_M, pos_bp, pop, subpop, iR , log10_pvalue)
significant_regions <- annotated_ir_result%>%
  filter(log10_pvalue >= 5) %>% 
  filter(!grepl("gene",Gene_name),!grepl("PF3D7",Gene_name))
load("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/isorelate/annotation_genes.rda")
# Plot with annotations
annotation_genes <- annotation_genes %>%
  mutate(chr = as.character(chr), start = as.integer(start))
p_annotated <- plotIBDiR(
    ibd.iR = my_iR,
    annotation.genes = annotation_genes,
    annotation.genes.color = c("black","red"),
    highlight.genes = NULL,
    highlight.genes.labels = FALSE,
    highlight.genes.color = NULL,
    highlight.genes.alpha = 0.1,
    point.size = 1,
    add.rug = FALSE,
    plot.title = "Significance of IBD sharing (with gene annotations)",
    add.legend = FALSE,
    facet.label = FALSE,
    facet.scales = "fixed"
  )


  
#ggsave("IBD_iR_plot_annotated.pdf", plot = p_annotated, width = 15, height = 10)


transform_coordinates <- function(my_iR, annotation_genes) {
  
  # Get unique chromosomes in order
  chromosomes <- unique(my_iR$chr)
  
  # Create copies to modify
  my_iR_transformed <- my_iR
  annotation_genes_transformed <- annotation_genes
  
  # Initialize variables
  chrstart <- 0
  
  # Transform coordinates for each chromosome
  for (i in 1:length(chromosomes)) {
    chr <- chromosomes[i]
    
    # Get max position for this chromosome from the iR data
    maxpos <- max(my_iR[my_iR$chr == chr, "pos_bp"])
    
    # Transform SNP positions
    my_iR_transformed[my_iR_transformed$chr == chr, "pos_bp"] <- 
      my_iR_transformed[my_iR_transformed$chr == chr, "pos_bp"] + chrstart
    
    # Transform annotation positions
    if (any(annotation_genes$chr == chr)) {
      annotation_genes_transformed[annotation_genes_transformed$chr == chr, "start"] <- 
        annotation_genes_transformed[annotation_genes_transformed$chr == chr, "start"] + chrstart
      
      annotation_genes_transformed[annotation_genes_transformed$chr == chr, "end"] <- 
        annotation_genes_transformed[annotation_genes_transformed$chr == chr, "end"] + chrstart
    }
    
    # Update chrstart for next chromosome
    chrstart <- chrstart + maxpos
  }
  
  return(list(
    iR = my_iR_transformed,
    annotations = annotation_genes_transformed
  ))
}

# Apply the transformation
transformed_data <- transform_coordinates(my_iR, annotation_genes)

# Filter for significant genes as before
overlaps <- findOverlaps(
  GRanges(seqnames = my_iR$chr, ranges = IRanges(start = my_iR$pos_bp, end = my_iR$pos_bp)),
  GRanges(seqnames = annotation_genes$chr, ranges = IRanges(start = annotation_genes$start, end = annotation_genes$end))
)

overlapping_snps <- my_iR[queryHits(overlaps), ]
significant_threshold <- 0.5  # Adjust as needed
significant_overlaps <- overlaps[overlapping_snps$log10_pvalue > significant_threshold]
significant_genes_original <- annotation_genes[subjectHits(significant_overlaps), ]

# Remove duplicates
significant_genes_original <- significant_genes_original[!duplicated(significant_genes_original$gene_id), ]

# Now transform the coordinates of these significant genes
significant_genes_transformed <- transform_coordinates(my_iR, significant_genes_original)$annotations


# Create the base plot
p_base <- plotIBDiR(
  ibd.iR = my_iR, 
  interval = NULL, 
  annotation.genes = NULL,
  point.size = 1,
  add.rug = FALSE, 
  plot.title = "Significance of IBD sharing", 
  add.legend = FALSE,
  facet.label = TRUE, 
  facet.scales = "fixed"
)



# Only show genes with very significant overlaps
high_sig_threshold <- 5
high_sig_overlaps <- overlaps[overlapping_snps$log10_pvalue > high_sig_threshold]

if (length(high_sig_overlaps) > 0) {
  # Get the high significance data
  high_sig_data <- data.frame(
    chr = overlapping_snps$chr[overlapping_snps$log10_pvalue > high_sig_threshold],
    pos_bp = overlapping_snps$pos_bp[overlapping_snps$log10_pvalue > high_sig_threshold],
    log10_pvalue = overlapping_snps$log10_pvalue[overlapping_snps$log10_pvalue > high_sig_threshold],
    gene_name = annotation_genes$name[subjectHits(high_sig_overlaps)]
  )
  
  # Add a color column based on gene name
  high_sig_data$gene_color <- ifelse(high_sig_data$gene_name %in% c("AP2-G","ABCK1"), "red", "grey")


  # Apply the SAME transformation that plotIBDiR uses
  # Get unique chromosomes in the same order as my_iR
  chromosomes <- unique(my_iR$chr)
  
  # Transform the high_sig_data coordinates
  high_sig_data_transformed <- high_sig_data
  chrstart <- 0
  
  for (i in 1:length(chromosomes)) {
    chr <- chromosomes[i]
    
    # Get max position for this chromosome from the original iR data
    maxpos <- max(my_iR[my_iR$chr == chr, "pos_bp"])
    
    # Transform positions for this chromosome
    chr_mask <- high_sig_data_transformed$chr == chr
    if (any(chr_mask)) {
      high_sig_data_transformed[chr_mask, "pos_bp"] <- 
        high_sig_data_transformed[chr_mask, "pos_bp"] + chrstart
    }
    
    # Update chrstart for next chromosome
    chrstart <- chrstart + maxpos
  }
  
  p_clean <- p_base +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = high_sig_data_transformed,
      aes(x = pos_bp, y = log10_pvalue, label = gene_name),
      color = high_sig_data_transformed$gene_color,  # Use color directly, not in aes()
      size = 3,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.3,
      max.overlaps = 20
    ) 
  
  ggsave("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/isorelate/IBD_clean_annotations_hrp_wild_wild.pdf", plot = p_clean, width = 15, height = 10)
}
```
